# Plan 8.1: Auto-Generated Passwords & Role Management Matrix

## Objective
Implement automatic secure password generation upon user account creation with one-click copy modal, and provide an interactive Role Management Matrix in `UserManagementView.tsx`.

## Context
- .gsd/SPEC.md
- .gsd/ROADMAP.md
- .gsd/phases/8/RESEARCH.md
- src/renderer/src/components/UserManagementView.tsx
- src/main/services/user.service.ts

## Tasks

<task type="auto">
  <name>Implement auto-generated password on user creation with copy modal</name>
  <files>src/renderer/src/components/UserManagementView.tsx</files>
  <action>
    In `src/renderer/src/components/UserManagementView.tsx`:
    - Add utility function to generate secure high-entropy temporary passwords (e.g. 12 characters with uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and special symbols).
    - When user opens "Create User" form or types a username, auto-populate password with a freshly generated secure password (with option to regenerate or edit).
    - Upon successful user creation:
      - Display a "Account Created & Credentials" modal showing the Username, Assigned Role, and the Auto-Generated Password.
      - Provide a prominent "Copy Password" button that copies credentials to clipboard and gives feedback ("Copied!").
  </action>
  <verify>npm run build</verify>
  <done>User creation automatically generates secure password and presents credentials modal with copy button.</done>
</task>

<task type="auto">
  <name>Implement Role Management & Permissions Matrix in UserManagementView</name>
  <files>src/renderer/src/components/UserManagementView.tsx</files>
  <action>
    In `src/renderer/src/components/UserManagementView.tsx`:
    - Add tab switching: "Users List" vs "Role Permissions Matrix".
    - In the Role Permissions Matrix tab:
      - Display a comprehensive grid of all 4 roles: `CASHIER`, `ACCOUNTANT`, `MANAGER`, `IT_PERSONNEL`.
      - Show which modules each role can access (Billing, Collections, Disbursements, Books of Accounts, Payroll, Voids, System Settings, etc.).
      - Allow editing role defaults or customizing permissions for users assigned to that role.
      - Clearly describe responsibilities for each role to satisfy SOP 3.3.
  </action>
  <verify>npm run build</verify>
  <done>UserManagementView includes active Role Management tab displaying role permissions matrix.</done>
</task>

## Success Criteria
- [ ] User creation auto-generates secure password by default.
- [ ] One-click copy modal provides temporary credentials.
- [ ] Role management matrix clearly displays and manages permissions for all roles.
